decisions.reason: The evening day-patient program builds on established psychiatric expertise, has its own page, and its uncertain but promising demand from working patients justifies keeping this low-cost option open.
The carpentry workshop draws on existing sheltered-workshop production know-how and infrastructure, so keeping it costs little while its market value is still being revealed.
Outpatient sociotherapy is close to the core business and reimbursed by health insurers, but its low website visibility suggests it is still uncertain, which favors waiting rather than abandoning it.
Senior living counseling is featured on the home page and serves growing demographic demand at minimal cost, signaling early positive resolution of uncertainty.
The retail shop has a fixed running cost and is only mentioned on the website, but it complements the workshop's sales and is too new to judge, so the option stays open for now.
